modules.module_title: Taking charge and handing over of shift in the packing department

pcs.pc_description: report for the shift 10-15 minutes before the scheduled time with necessary operational tools
discuss with the previous shift packer and gather the shift details on production, count wise finished packages stock, colour coding, non- conforming packages, etc. as per the SOP

check the condition and availability of packing materials, equipment such as packing fixer, strapping machine, weigh scale, pallet wrapper, trolley, HDPE sack, twine, needle, strap, carton box, carton pads, PE covers, disk, packing slip, cone label, etc.
provide shift details to the incoming packer on production, availability of packing materials, running counts, availability of finished packages, etc.
complete the shift end jobs like writing production log report, waste collection, waste disposal, cleaning as per standard protocol
report the observed deviation to the incoming shift supervisor on production, maintenance, absenteeism, etc.
get clearance from the incoming packer and shift supervisor before leaving the shift
identify the finished cone packages to be inspected as per the given datasheet
transport the finished cone packages from the storage area to the inspection table using the trolley
inspect the finished cone packages visually for damages such as stitch, bad shape, stains, ribboning, tail end missing, cut end, etc.
correct the mendable defects in packages as per the SOP
store the rejected cone packages in the allotted area
inspect the finished cone packages under the Ultra Violet (UV) light for mix-ups
weight and segregate the weight varied cones
segregate the non-conforming packages such as weight varied packages, poorly conditioned packages, etc.
paste verification sticker and description label to inspected packages with the details of investigator or checker code, approvals such as OK, quality OK, tested OK, count, weight, etc.
record finished cone inspection data in the given register
prepare cone packing material checklist based on the type of packing such as carton packing, hessian packing, pallet packing, etc. and their quantity
procure the packing materials from the store using standard procurement or requisition form
record the procured materials data in the allocated record
check the condition of packing equipment required for finished cone packing
clean packages using the allotted brush, if required
wrap the cone packages with a polythene cover and put disk inserts, if required
maintain defective and non-confirmed packages separately, if found at the time of random checking

modules.module_title: Carryout packing of cones using carton box

pcs.pc_description: prepare the carton box with required specifications such as the bottom, middle, top pieces, polyethylene covers, etc.
arrange the required number of cone packages inside the carton box in a specified manner
close the flaps by tape sealing as per requirement
carryout strapping by using the strapping machine as per the requirement
carryout stencil marking or sticker pasting on the surface of the carton box

modules.module_title: Carryout packing of cones using a hessian bag

pcs.pc_description: prepare the hessian bag at packing fixer as per the requirement
stitch the top portion of the hessian bag by providing the “handle” at the corner of the bags

modules.module_title: Carryout packing of cones using pallet

pcs.pc_description: arrange cone packages layer by layer on the pallet concerning the pallet size
set the pallet packing machine for wrapping activity
operate the pallet packing machine to wrap film sheet around pallet with required cardboard inserts and pads
fix the strap to the wrapped pallet using prescribed strapping hand tools

modules.module_title: Perform other responsibilities in the packing department

pcs.pc_description: transport finished packages to yarn godown using specified material handling tools such as trolley, etc. for stacking as per guidelines
check the functioning of equipment such as UV light, weigh scale, packing fixer, inspection table, trolley, etc.
segregate the paper waster and plastic waste as per the guidelines
